software.name: FTDI VCP Driver
software.summary: Virtual COM port driver

packages.name: ftdi-vcp-driver
packages.title: FTDI VCP Driver
packages.description: Virtual COM port driver

sourceDetails.caveats:
Once you've rebooted, you can (re)connect your FTDI
device and it will show up in /dev, usually like this:

  /dev/tty.usbserial-XXXXXXXX

where XXXXXXXX is a random ID, based on the serial number.

To uninstall the driver, you must use the GUI to move the
application from /Applications/FTDIUSBSerialDextInstaller.app to Trash,
otherwise the system extension will not be removed.

You must reboot for the installation of ftdi-vcp-driver to take effect.

sourceDetails.caveats:
If an old PostgreSQL data directory ($HOMEBREW_PREFIX/var/postgres) still exists,
you can migrate to a versioned data directory by running:
  mv -v "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/var/postgres" "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/var/postgresql@14"

(Make sure PostgreSQL is stopped before executing this command)

This formula has created a default database cluster with:
  initdb --locale=en_US.UTF-8 -E UTF-8 $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/var/postgresql@14
